meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein online **women’s kurta sets** ke liye ye brands achhe options hain:

- **Libas** – office wear, daily wear aur festive sets; cotton/cotton-blend options, roughly ₹999–₹1,449 ke aas-paas. [8]
- **Biba** – polished ethnic look aur better finishing; Flipkart par kurta sets available hain. [2]
- **W for Woman** – elegant office aur semi-formal styles ke liye. [2]
- **Aurelia** – comfortable, contemporary Indian wear; everyday use ke liye achha. [2]
- **Indo Era** – affordable embroidered, A-line aur printed 3-piece sets; Amazon par kaafi variety. [5][6]
- **GoSriKi** – budget-friendly rayon/viscose 3-piece sets, dupatta ke saath; casual aur festive wear ke liye. [1][5]
- **Anouk** – modern prints aur fusion-style kurta sets. [7]
- **Gerua by Libas** – stylish designs, generally discounted prices par milte hain. [7][9]
- **Nermosa** – cotton aur hand-block printed sets; summer/day outings ke liye. [6]
- **Meesho sellers** – ₹200–₹500 range mein budget options, lekin reviews, fabric aur return policy zaroor check karein. [4]

**Quick recommendation:**
- **Best overall:** Libas  
- **Office wear:** Aurelia ya W for Woman  
- **Budget:** GoSriKi ya Indo Era  
- **Festive wear:** Biba ya Libas embroidered sets  
- **Cotton/summer:** Nermosa ya Libas cotton sets  

Buy karne se pehle fabric, size chart, customer photos, rating aur return policy check karein—especially rayon/viscose sets mein actual color aur fitting product photos se alag ho sakti hai.
